# worker_completion_tool

> Signal that your dispatched work is COMPLETE.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `orchestration` |
| Callable | MCP clients; grantable to agents |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=worker_completion_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

Signal that your dispatched work is COMPLETE. Call this as your FINAL action once you have
finished the task you were dispatched for (after pushing your branch / opening your MR /
recording your artifact). It authoritatively closes your worker session and hands your
result back to the orchestration so it advances without waiting on session-timeout inference.
Do NOT call it before your work is fully done.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `state` | string | yes | completed if the work succeeded; failed if you could not complete it. One of: `completed`, `failed`. |
| `output` | string | yes | Short summary of what you accomplished (or, on failure, what blocked you) |
| `artifacts` | array of object | no | Optional result references, e.g. [{key, mr_url, changed_files}]. |
